rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] went over the close call, step by step, until it was only a story.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] how the hurt was mending, and they ended up talking about [topic].
topic->the work waiting, and who would do it
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] that being afraid of the place for a while was only sense.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about the close call, and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] laughed about it for the first time.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] sat with [RECIPIENT_nameDef] a while and let [RECIPIENT_objective] tell it as many times as [RECIPIENT_pronoun] needed.

ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: back to it
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: One of the dangers on the map hurt someone, and they are shaken: a day of it, a word about it with the one closest to them, the first real work back at what it happened at, and then it's just work again.

li.label: shaken
li.waiting: Next: a word about it with {OTHER_nameDef}.

plain.li: It keeps playing over in my head, how close it came. My hands shook all through supper.
I'm all right, everyone keeps saying so. I'm not sure I believe them yet.
[arcskill:Mining] I keep hearing the rock give, every time it goes quiet.
[arcskill:Plants] Walked past the place this morning and went the long way round.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} came to find me straight after, and stayed. I didn't have to ask.

blunt.li: Nearly got done for today. Still here. Leave it.

cheerful.li: Still in one piece, more or less, and I've got a story nobody else here can tell.

gloomy.li: This land tried to kill me today, and it'll try again.

cold.li: I was careless, and I was hurt. I am working out where the mistake was.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} had a close call today. I'll keep an eye on {OTHER_objective} for a day or two.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} is shaken after a close call, and {OTHER_nameDef} is keeping close.
The close call has left {PAWN_nameDef} shaken, and {OTHER_nameDef} has noticed.

plain.li: I need to talk about it with someone, and {OTHER_nameDef} is the one I'd pick.
Every time I close my eyes I'm back there for a moment, then I'm here again.
[night] I couldn't sleep, so I lay there going over it, and over it.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} said to come and find {OTHER_objective} whenever I want to talk about it. I might.

blunt.li: Should talk to {OTHER_nameDef} about it. Haven't.

cheerful.li: I've told the story four times now and it gets better every time, which means I'm fine.

gloomy.li: Nobody wants to hear about it again, except maybe {OTHER_nameDef}.

cold.li: Talking it through would settle it, I expect. {OTHER_nameDef} would listen.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} wants to talk the close call over with {OTHER_nameDef}.
{PAWN_nameDef} still goes over the close call, and is waiting for a quiet word with {OTHER_nameDef}.

li.label: back at the work
li.waiting: Next: some real work at {SKILL} again.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I talked it through. It sounded smaller out loud than it did in my head.
Went back to the work today, slowly, watching everything twice.
[arcskill:Mining] Back at the rock face today, with an ear to the roof the whole time.
[arcskill:Plants] Out among the plants again today, and nothing fell on me.
[arcskill:Crafting] Back at the bench, and I checked every piece before I touched it.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} let me tell it all, twice, and then said I'd be fine. I think {OTHER_pronoun}'s right.

blunt.li: Talked to {OTHER_nameDef}. Back to work now.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} laughed at the part where I yelped, and so did I, and that was that.

gloomy.li: Back at the work. I'm waiting for it to happen again.

cold.li: The talk was useful. I've gone back to the work with better habits.

plain.li: Sat with {OTHER_nameDef} and let {OTHER_objective} tell me about the close call. I think it helped.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has talked the close call over with {OTHER_nameDef}, and is getting back to {SKILL}.
After a word with {OTHER_nameDef}, {PAWN_nameDef} is back at the work, carefully.

plain.li: Worked all day without thinking about it once. It's just work again.
I walked past the place today and only noticed afterwards.
[arcskill:Mining] Dug a whole new face today, and only looked up at the roof twice.

warm.li: I told {OTHER_nameDef} I'm past it now, and thanked {OTHER_objective} for the talk.

cheerful.li: Back to my old self, and I've got a scar to show for it.

gloomy.li: It's just work again, until the next time something goes wrong.

cold.li: The matter is closed. I have changed how I work, and that is enough.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is back to {OTHER_possessive} old self. I didn't do much, but I was there.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} is past the close call, and it's just work again.
The close call is behind {PAWN_nameDef} now, with {OTHER_nameDef}'s help.

plain.li: [otherdead] {OTHER_nameDef} sat with me after the close call, and now {OTHER_nameDef} is gone.
[otherleft] {OTHER_nameDef} has gone, and I never did talk it all through.
[timeout] I still go the long way round that place. Maybe I always will.
It still comes back to me, the close call, now and then.

fizzleChronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} still hasn't quite shaken off the close call.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} had only just got over a close call, and was back at the work. I sat with {OTHER_objective} after it.
